release.headline: Subshell 0.91: export your Reddit data, and update from inside the app
highlights: Settings › Updates shows your version and the newest one and checks on request. From the next release on, Update downloads it, checks it and hands it to Android to install.
When a new version is out, a notice says so. Close it and it stays away for a day.
Settings › Accounts › Export your Reddit data saves your saved posts, votes, posts, comments, communities and messages as a ZIP in Downloads.
Optional: tap a post's title to hide its text, like a comment. Turn it on in Settings › Comments & notifications.
More replies, community icons and find in thread work more reliably in big threads and ask Reddit less often.
